values: deltas from the rest pose of the node in the current view: position += [dx,dy], rotation_degrees += r, scale *= [sx,sy]; modulate:a, visible, frame are absolute
key_format: [t_sec, value..., transition]; transition = Godot Animation key transition (ease curve): 1 linear, 0 constant/hold, 0.5 ease-out, 2 ease-in, -2 ease-in-out (same as Godot ease())
layers: base = AnimationPlayer "Body" (one loop at a time); overlay = AnimationPlayer "Overlay" (one-shots on pip.r / pip.s / head.r / fx / swaps only)

list.desc: Breathing idle: chest rise, head lag, ear drift, nose twitch, one blink. Base loop on field, card, Arena, Wardrobe stage.
Season card (230): same breathing idle, Pip looks at the player.
Wardrobe stage (1032×300) idle loop in 3/4.
Arena idle. Leaves head.rotation and eye position free for look-at.
HUD portrait (88) idle: breathing + blink.
Idle variant: glance left, then right, ears tracking.
Idle variant: left ear flicks, folded tip answers a beat later (overlap).
Idle variant: grooming — paws scrub the face, eyes shut, head rocks.
Idle variant: periscoping — rises on hind legs, paws tucked, scans the field.
Idle variant: the bunny flop — throws itself on its side, blissful, then rights itself.
Idle variant / joy: binky — leap with a mid-air twist and kick, ears flailing.
Sniff a flower (field): lean 7° toward it, head dips, fast nose. Flower bows via SNIFF_BOW.
Pollen sneeze: nose builds up, "choo!" jerk, ears flap, puff.
Hind-foot thump (annoyed/alert): foot lifts and slams, dust, body jolts.
Idle variant: yawn and stretch — arms out, ears long.
A new flower grew: gasp, sparkle eyes, paws clasped, happy sway, a heart.
Sleep loop: squashed loaf, ears down, slow breath, three z (same timing as UiSeasons.SLEEP_ZZZ).
Drowsy nod into the sleep loaf.
Startled awake: ears snap up with overshoot, "!", head shake.
Field walk = rabbit hop cycle, 0.42 s (= UiSeasons.PIP_BOB_SEC). Hind feet push, front paws reach, ears drag and whip.
Tap 1: giggle — squash, happy eyes, wiggle, a note.
Tap 2: surprised hop — "!", ears straight up, wide eyes.
Tap 3: huff — turns face away, eyes shut, thump.
Tap 4+: dramatic faint — swoons over, peeks with one eye, gets up.
ApplyMoment (Wardrobe): hop in the new skin 1→1.18→1, 280 ms after 40 ms, feet pivot, + cream ring 90→220 field px / 500 ms (UiWardrobe).
Welcome back: happy bounce, paw wave, ear perk.
Season card → field: crouch, leap (code moves the box along the Home v3 path), land.
A butterfly lands on Pip's nose → cross-eyed → sneeze → it flutters off.
Finds a dandelion clock, big breath, blows — five seeds drift off.
Catches a falling snowflake on its tongue, shivers, grins.
A clump of snow drops on its head; Pip shakes it off like a wet dog.
A firefly circles Pip's head (eyes follow), lands on the nose, gets a boop, floats away.
A firefly settles on the tip of the tall ear; Pip goes cross-eyed, holds still, then flicks it off.
A falling leaf lands on Pip's head; Pip wears it proudly until it slides off.
An acorn bonks Pip on the head, bounces away; Pip winces, then sniffs it curiously.
Pip digs at its own little burrow: leans in, tail wiggling, flings dirt, pops up proud.
Periscopes to gaze at the moon; three stars twinkle for Pip.
A sea bubble wobbles up; Pip watches, boops it with the nose — pop!
A seashell appears; Pip tilts its head and listens to the sea, eyes closed, notes rising.
A meteor streaks by; Pip gasps, clasps paws, closes eyes and makes a wish.
A star petal drifts down; Pip cups its paws and catches it, it glows, then floats back up.
A drift of marsh smoke reaches Pip; three little coughs, a paw waves it away.
A warm ember floats up; Pip holds its paws out to it, cosy sway, it drifts away.
Merge to ★2: small happy hop.
Merge to ★3: full binky, sparkles.
Combo ×2–4, ×6: COMBO_PIP.hop 1.18 / 0.28 s (pivot feet) — overlay on idle.
Combo ×5: COMBO_PIP.big 1.26 / 0.36 s + lift.
Muncher wakes: Pip startles, ears bolt upright, "!".
Muncher eats a seed: worried, paws to chest, trembling, sweat drop.
Muncher frozen: relief, proud little hop.
New seeds arrive in the basket: double bounce, sparkle eyes.
"Need more seeds": ears droop, eyes down, sigh.
No input for 20 s: dozes in the corner — slow nods that snap back up.
Rabbit gallop seen from above: hind pair pushes together, front paws alternate, spine flexes, ears flap. Contact phases are linear so feet stay locked to the ground at any scroll speed.
Lane change ←: lean + squash in the first 0.12 s (player.gd tween 0.12 quad-out moves x), settle by 0.22. Overlay: pip.r / pip.s / head.r only.
Lane change → (mirror of lane_left).
Coin: quick pop + happy blink.
Seed: bigger pop, head wiggle, joy.
Start: crouch, ears pressed back, launch into the gallop (event "go").
Hit: impact squash (0–0.06), knocked back and tumbling (0.06–0.40), lands dizzy and splayed. Stays inside the lane (±0 x, +44 y). Last frame held → Loot screen backdrop.
Held dizzy pose behind the Loot screen: head wobble, two stars orbit.
Goal (FINISH_TOTAL 0.62): world slows to 0 in 0.3 s (speed_scale follows), Pip sits up — head comes closer, ears perk sideways, a happy hop.
After Revive: from the dizzy pose, head shake, ears snap back, hop into the gallop.
HUD: coin / seed picked up.
HUD: last 17 % of time (RING_LOW).
HUD: finish.
HUD: hit — dizzy, held into Loot.
HUD: run start — determined nod.
Showcase pose Classic: friendly wave, folded tip swung.
Showcase pose Blossom: head tilted to show the sprig, paws clasped, dreamy.
Showcase pose Sky: periscoped tall, looking up at the sky, cloud tips high.
Signature Classic (tap, 1.3 s): the ear-flip — folded tip springs straight up during a binky, then flops back with a bounce.
Signature Blossom (tap, 1.4 s): a twirl on the spot that sheds six petals.
Signature Sky (tap, 1.5 s): cloud hop — springs up on two puffs and floats down slowly, swaying.
Wardrobe stage pick: 1 → 1.12 → 1, y −11 % (T_STAGE_HOP 0.28).
